title: FCC Chair Proposes Allowing Prisons to Jam Illegal Phones
excerpt: The FCC plans to vote next month on a proposal that would allow prisons to use signal jammers to block illegal cellphones.
body_html:
The chair of the Federal Communications Commission is moving to change the agency's long-standing opposition to the use of signal-jamming technology inside correctional facilities.

Under the new proposal, the agency will hold a vote next month regarding whether to permit prisons to jam unauthorized mobile phones. For years, the regulatory body has maintained strict rules against the use of such equipment to prevent interference with external commercial networks.
